label: Fantasy Attire
description: Non-armor fantasy costume — robes, cloaks and court dress; the soft counterpart to wardrobe/armor. Tagged 'fantasy' for genre coupling.

items.name: sorceress-gown
items.text: a midnight sorceress gown, tight sleeves ending in pointed cuffs over the hands, silver sigils embroidered along the hems

items.name: elven-court-gown
items.text: an elven court gown of grey-green silk, trailing split sleeves, leaf-vine embroidery in silver thread

items.name: ranger-cloak
items.text: a weathered ranger cloak with a deep hood, layered wool over oiled-leather bracers and a quiver strap

items.name: royal-mantle
items.text: an ermine-trimmed royal mantle over cloth-of-gold, jeweled clasp at the throat, train sweeping the steps

items.name: witch-layers
items.text: layered witch attire, tattered charcoal skirts, a corseted bodice hung with charms, wide-brim pointed hat

items.name: battlemage-coat
items.text: a high-collared battlemage coat, rune-stitched leather panels, scorch marks at the cuffs

items.name: druid-vestments
items.text: druid vestments of undyed wool and woven bark, antler talismans, a moss-green mantle pinned with a bronze brooch

items.name: barbarian-furs
items.text: northern barbarian furs, a wolf-pelt mantle over a studded leather jerkin, fur-wrapped boots

items.name: desert-mystic
items.text: desert mystic robes, layered sand-toned gauze, coin-fringed sash and veils lifting in the wind

items.name: fae-gossamer
items.text: a fae gown of layered gossamer, dew-beaded cobweb lace at the shoulders, iridescent wing-sheen fabric shifting color as it moves
